text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen is 1,600 meters<n>long. It's just
barely within the limit<n>of what I can run. On top of
that, I'm<n>up against Taiki, and the track is<n>heavy...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Conditions are looking bleak, but if I<n>run well
despite all these<n>disadvantages, I'm sure everyone
will see my strength for what it really<n>is!
